changelog:
Initial release of Agent Memory Optimizer.

- Scans MEMORY.md and memory/*.md for duplicates, stale entries, structure, and indexing issues.
- Generates a detailed markdown report with a Memory Efficiency Score and actionable recommendations.
- Auto-fix capabilities: deduplicates, re-indexes, reorganizes, and creates backups.
- Uses only Python standard library; no external dependencies required.
- Simple installation—just copy and run, no pip needed.
- Flexible CLI for analysis, reporting, and automated optimizations.
summary: Analyzes AI agent memory files to detect duplicates, stale info, missing indexes, and structure issues, generating detailed reports and auto-fix options.
